AI Concerns Grow, Obama Warns of Potential Dangers

Concerns are rising about the rapid advancement and potential dangers of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Former US President Barack Obama has expressed significant worry, stating that while AI companies' valuations might be hyped, the technology itself is not overhyped. He believes AI is rapidly learning and that increased self-learning capabilities could accelerate its speed, potentially posing a threat to humans.
